title: chat.rs get_changes_since_ordered missing >0 sentinel guard
description: get_changes_since uses 'created_at > since_counter && created_at > 0' but get_changes_since_ordered uses only 'created > since_counter'. The >0 guard is functionally redundant (0 > any positive since_counter is always false) but the asymmetry looks like a missing guard and will confuse future maintainers. Add >0 to get_changes_since_ordered for consistency.
